high_level_description: The image depicts a woman standing on a balcony with a scenic view of the ocean and a marina filled with yachts. She is wearing an elegant, strapless gown that features a fitted bodice adorned with sparkling embellishments and a flowing skirt with a colorful, abstract print at the bottom. The dress is predominantly blue, complemented by a statement necklace and matching earrings. The woman has her hair styled in an updo and is accessorized with multiple bracelets on one wrist.
